description.en: One independent steep coastal remnant with a continuous irregular cliff mass and a coherent wave-eroded lower notch, supported by a broad stable foot. Landscape scale retained: nominal 4 m height is a teaching art choice, not an exact locality, measured stack or unit-normalized stone. No water exported.
